office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Asotin County and is the legal adviser to the county commissioners and county offices.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecutor Curt L. Liedkie, in office since 2023, is the only candidate; he says the office is short-staffed after the county cut a deputy prosecutor position.

candidates.summary: Asotin County Prosecuting Attorney since 2023, a prosecutor for more than 25 years, running unopposed for a full term.
highlights: Prosecutor for three and a half years, since the loss of Prosecutor Benjamin Nichols in 2023; elected unopposed in 2024 [S1][S5]
More than 25 years as a prosecuting attorney [S1]
Says the commissioners cut funding for a third deputy prosecutor, leaving the office short-staffed [S1]
